scenarios.title: A Native page that calls confirm() and then prompt() shows each as the pane overlay naming its origin; Confirm and Submit with 'héllo 世界' give the page true and that text
An unanswered Native confirm() closes its overlay after 120 seconds and the page receives false
A basic-auth page shows the Native sign-in overlay; signing in with the right credentials loads the authenticated page, and pane state never contains the password
A Native attachment download appears in the shelf with a collision-free name in Downloads, shows bytes, completes, and Show in folder reveals it in Finder
A form POST to target=oauth opens a small window titled by the popup's origin; the popup sees window.opener and the POST body, and its window.close() closes the window
